subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Death and Rebirth
description: A short lesson to help you apply Death and Rebirth.

hook.text: Jesus died and rose in three days. Osiris was killed and reassembled. Heroes die and come back changed.

buildup.text: Symbolic death is the core engine of the monomyth. The old self must die for the new self to live.

discovery.text: Odin hung on Yggdrasil for nine days and gained the runes. Sacrifice is the price of wisdom.

twist.text: The rebirth isn't always joyful. The reborn hero carries scars and grief. Resurrection costs something.

climax.text: Every initiation ritual across cultures reenacts death and rebirth. The pattern is universal.

punchline.text: You die as who you were. You wake as who you must be.

quiz.question: What did Odin sacrifice to gain the runes?
options: His eye and nine days on Yggdrasil
